name: Wiki Masters Discord Bot
author: frflo@users.noreply.github.com
description: Bun + SQLite Discord bot for Wiki Masters.
startup: if [ -d /home/container/.git ]; then if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then git -C /home/container -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" pull --ff-only origin "${GITHUB_BRANCH:-main}" || echo 'Git pull failed; continuing with the current files.'; else git -C /home/container pull --ff-only origin "${GITHUB_BRANCH:-main}" || echo 'Git pull failed; continuing with the current files.'; fi; fi; mkdir -p /home/container/data && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run start

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
: "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:=https://github.com/FRFlo/wiki-masters-pack-opener.git}"
: "${GITHUB_BRANCH:=main}"
if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    AUTH_HEADER="AUTHORIZATION: bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}"
    git -c http.extraheader="${AUTH_HEADER}" clone --branch "${GITHUB_BRANCH}" "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" /tmp/wiki-masters-bot
else
    git clone --branch "${GITHUB_BRANCH}" "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" /tmp/wiki-masters-bot
fi
cp -a /tmp/wiki-masters-bot/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /tmp/wiki-masters-bot
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
    echo 'The Wiki Masters repository did not contain package.json.' >&2
    exit 1
fi
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data
echo 'Wiki Masters bot repository cloned successfully.'

startup_commands.Default: if [ -d /home/container/.git ]; then if [ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]; then git -C /home/container -c http.extraheader="AUTHORIZATION: bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}" pull --ff-only origin "${GITHUB_BRANCH:-main}" || echo 'Git pull failed; continuing with the current files.'; else git -C /home/container pull --ff-only origin "${GITHUB_BRANCH:-main}" || echo 'Git pull failed; continuing with the current files.'; fi; fi; mkdir -p /home/container/data && bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run start

variables.name: Git repository
variables.description: Repository URL to clone during installation.

variables.name: GitHub token
variables.description: Token used to clone a private GitHub repository.

variables.name: Discord guild ID
variables.description: Discord server/guild ID for command registration.

variables.name: Catalog sync interval
variables.description: Autocomplete catalog refresh interval in milliseconds.
